title: Safe experiment curriculum mapping
scope: Supplementary mapping for classroom-friendly demonstrations only. This file does not replace the official textbook review and does not claim to be the official lesson order.
notes: Use the official Ministry book portals for the final unit order.
These packs are safe teaching previews that can sit beside the official book mapping.
Senior 2 remains pathway-dependent; confirm the student's actual pathway before lesson planning.

sources.title: State Information Service — Ministry clarification on first-secondary subjects
Official Gazette — Decree 213/2025 on the Egyptian Baccalaureate

grade_mappings.label: Prep 1
grade_mappings.teacher_notes: Use these previews to explain matter, mixture, solution and physical change ideas before moving to more advanced lessons.

grade_mappings.label: Prep 2
grade_mappings.teacher_notes: Use the pack for solute/solvent language, saturation and concentration discussions in the virtual lab.

grade_mappings.label: Prep 3
grade_mappings.teacher_notes: Use the pack for separation methods, mixtures and indicator-based observation only.

grade_mappings.label: Senior 1
grade_mappings.teacher_notes: Use the pack to show slow change, model limits and how to interpret a simplified simulation.

grade_mappings.label: Senior 2
grade_mappings.teacher_notes: Use this as a gateway step only. The exact chemistry lesson set must follow the student's official pathway.
